summary: Comstock Inc. filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, disclosing the sale of membership interests in Comstock Mining LLC, Comstock Processing LLC, Comstock Exploration and Development LLC, and all shares of Comstock Real Estate Inc. to Mackay Precious Metals Inc. and Mackay Gold Silver Corp. Total consideration includes $20M cash, 2M shares of Mackay Parent common stock, a $7M deferred payment, assumption of reclamation obligations, and a contingent $10M payment. The board did not publicly recommend, but terms include a 1.5% NSR royalty with repurchase rights. Closing is expected in early July 2026, subject to TSX-V approval. Watch for regulatory clearance and contingent payment triggers.
